def get_quadrant(r, c, r_min, r_max, c_min, c_max):
    """Returns quadrant relative to rectangle [r_min:r_max+1] x [c_min:c_max+1]"""
    if r < r_min:  # Above rectangle
        if c < c_min:
            return "TL"  # Top-left
        else:
            return "TR"  # Top-right
    elif r >= r_max:  # Below rectangle  
        if c < c_min:
            return "BL"  # Bottom-left
        else:
            return "BR"  # Below-right
    else:  # Inside horizontal span but not vertical
        return "S"  # Same row range

# Demo 2x2: rows 3-4, cols 3-4
